title: Ads follow the conversation
summary:
Text API work made affiliate copy more context-aware and browser errors readable, with analytics plumbing added behind the scenes.

Affiliate ad copy is now written to match the response and recent conversation instead of translating existing ad text. The ad marker is kept out of messages sent to the text model.

Non-OK responses from the text origin now include a CORS header, so cross-origin browser requests can inspect the error.

A non-cacheable tracking-pixel function was added for request analytics.
